title: Naturality of strict tensor tower reindexing
statement:
theorem podReindexingStrictTensorTowersNaturality
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (hD : PodCompletionReindex.QuotientGenerators l E g D)
    (τ : ∀ P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory,
        (podReindexTower l E g).obj
            ((integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E Y).obj (P.obj,Q.obj)) ≅
          (integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E X).obj
            (((podGoodReindex l E g D).obj P).obj,((podGoodReindex l E g D).obj Q).obj))
    (hgen : ∀ (P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory)
        (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ) (U : X.ProEt)
        (x : (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj P.obj).X p).val.obj
          (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U)))
        (y : (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj Q.obj).X q).val.obj
          (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U))),
        ((((τ P Q).hom.app (op n)).f (p + q)).val.app (op U))
            (integralOperationsTotalTensorSection l E Y n P.obj Q.obj p q
              (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U)) x y) =
          integralOperationsTotalTensorSection l E X n
            (((podGoodReindex l E g D).obj P).obj) (((podGoodReindex l E g D).obj Q).obj)
            p q (op U) ((((D.quotient P.obj P.property n).hom.f p).val.app (op U)) x)
              ((((D.quotient Q.obj Q.property n).hom.f q).val.app (op U)) y)) :
      ∀ (P Q P' Q' : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory)
        (a : P ⟶ P') (b : Q ⟶ Q'),
        (podReindexTower l E g).map
            ((integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E Y).map (Prod.mkHom a.hom b.hom)) ≫
            (τ P' Q').hom =
          (τ P Q).hom ≫ (integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E X).map
            (Prod.mkHom ((podGoodReindex l E g D).map a).hom
              ((podGoodReindex l E g D).map b).hom)

proof.text: Apply the quotient generator normalization at scalar one. Since the coefficient transport preserves one, D.quotient sends the reduction unit of each original section to the corresponding reindexed reduction unit. The assumed tensor formula therefore computes τ on tensors of reduced original sections.

Precompose the desired naturality equation with the inverse of τ(P,Q), cancel the adjacent inverse-hom pair on the right, and apply tower, chain-map, and finite tensor generator extensionality. The latter is the proved finite_tensor_ext helper in IntegralScalarTensorLevelReduction.

Evaluate τ.hom_inv_id on the original tensor generator. Together with the normalized generator formula this computes τ inverse on the target generator. Reindexing has the same underlying section maps, and evaluation of a strict tensor tower map gives its finite-level tensor map; both component identities follow by reflexivity.

Use the proved finite_tensor_map_section and finite_reduction_map_section helpers in IntegralScalarTensorLevelTower on both sides. The source composite first maps the two original sections and then applies the normalized τ formula; the target composite reduces their reindexed images. The sectionwise reindexing model identifies these sections definitionally, closing the generator equality.

statement_change.what: The earlier statement omitted normalization of D.quotient. The structure gives objectwise isomorphisms, not a natural family. For identity reindexing, multiplying the quotient isomorphism for one nonzero good representative by -1, and its tensor comparison by the product of the two signs, preserves the stated generator formula and tower compatibility but need not preserve a morphism between two representatives. For odd residue characteristic, a nonzero inclusion between finite free representatives detects the failure. The source uses the fixed normalized quotient comparison. Add only its existing QuotientGenerators law; the parent already assumes all Laws. No target or parent statement changes.
